injuries.detail: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Washington.
VanVleet (right knee injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Johnson (back) won't play in Sunday's game against Houston, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
